criterion_fired: CRITERION 2 (Carry-forward consistency) and CRITERION 4 (Next steps specificity)
suggested_change: Criterion 2 should clarify: 'Scores at Identified or Partial remain unchanged unless recent call data explicitly contradicts the component. Absence of re-validation in a single call does not constitute contradiction. Carry forward with confidence level note (e.g., Last validated: Call 1) and flag re-validation gaps for follow-up.' Criterion 4 should require: 'Next steps must include: (a) assigned owner, (b) specific date or deadline, (c) concrete deliverable or question, not placeholder verbs like confirm/walk-through.'
